limitations: Native scheduler fixture is Debian 12 with Python 3.11.2; it does not prove scheduled execution on every distribution or Python version.

interpretation: Workflow success means its acceptance contract passed; individual audited hosts can correctly have failed or manual findings.
Counts belong to these exact images, source database snapshots and workflow attempts. CVE x package entries, unique CVEs, OVAL definitions and compliance rules are distinct quantities.
Native/HCP agreement verifies this integration and conservation of results; it does not establish universal precision or recall of the upstream scanner.
Labelled synthetic package controls test specific vendor matching and backport cases; they are not installed-vulnerable-host or exploitation tests.
Complete selected-source execution does not imply full CVE coverage. Unknown evidence remains partial/manual with no global security score.
No production host was changed. Native acceptance used disposable VMs and isolated lab fixtures.
Full CI artifacts have workflow-specific retention periods. Their exact artifact IDs and digests are retained here for traceability.
